newsitem.title: USA: Nimbus CD sees charge from consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Nimbus CD sees charge from consolidation.

text.p: In a move the company says will result in a fourth quarter charge, Nimbus Manufacturing Inc, a subsidiary of Nimbus CD International Inc, said Tuesday it is repositioning operations by implementing a two-plant strategy to service the U.S. market for CD and DVD disc replication.
The company also said it is acquiring eight additional production lines to bring its U.S. annual capacity to 185 million discs.

The two-plant strategy will involve the consolidation of production into Nimbus' existing Provo, Utah and Charlottesville, Va., plants and the closure of its Sunnyvale, Calif., facility, the company said.

As a result of this repositioning and the closure of the Sunnyvale plant, Nimbus said it will incur a one-time charge to its fourth quarter financial results of about $3.7 million, or $0.16 per share, after tax.
The transition of operations will begin immediately and is scheduled for completion by June 1, 1997, the company said.
